-- Check distinct matchref values to understand race grouping
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT matchref) FROM sprint_results;

-- Check how many participants per matchref and what the top 8 look like
SELECT matchref, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM sprint_results GROUP BY matchref ORDER BY matchref;

-- Calculate SPI for top 8 finishers in each sprint and get overall average
SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG((9 - (sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int) + (sprint_performance->>'points')::int)::numeric, 2) as avg_spi
FROM sprint_results
WHERE (sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int <= 8;

-- Verify: show the SPI values for a sample to confirm calculation
SELECT 
    matchref,
    sprint_performance->>'final_position' as fin_pos,
    sprint_performance->>'points' as pts,
    (9 - (sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int) + (sprint_performance->>'points')::int as spi
FROM sprint_results
WHERE (sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int <= 8
ORDER BY matchref, fin_pos
LIMIT 20;
